description: This file defines the StreamDeliveryFailureEntity class used for representing delivery failure records in Azure Table Storage within Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes properties for tracking failure details, methods for generating storage keys, and for handling serialization of sequence tokens.

classes.name: StreamDeliveryFailureEntity
classes.description: Represents a delivery failure entry in Azure Table Storage, including metadata such as subscription, stream details, and sequence tokens, along with methods to set partition and row keys.

methods.name: SetPartitionKey
methods.description: Sets the PartitionKey property using the stream provider name and deployment id.

methods.name: MakeDefaultPartitionKey
methods.description: Generates a default partition key string based on stream provider name and deployment id.

methods.name: SetRowkey
methods.description: Sets the RowKey property using a timestamp and GUID.

methods.name: SetSequenceToken
methods.description: Serializes a StreamSequenceToken into the SequenceToken byte array.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Deserializes the byte array back into a StreamSequenceToken.

methods.name: ReverseOrderTimestampTicks
methods.description: Calculates a timestamp in ticks that orders latest events first by subtracting current time ticks from max value.
